metadata.notes: Direct USB ALSA retest resolved the transport mapping: B9 57 03 arms all channels in overdub/overburn mode; BA 57 03 starts playback; BB 57 03 stops transport. Any previous interpretation of B9 as REC was incorrect and has been superseded. Scene SAVE is confirmed: B9 56 03 saves the currently selected scene over USB ALSA. BB 56 03 was tested and selects scene 1; it is not DELETE. Scene DELETE remains unknown. Correction from direct hardware retest: BD 56 03 selects scene 3. The earlier interpretation as entering scene mode was incorrect. Additional scene mapping confirmed over USB ALSA: BC 56 03 -> scene 2; BE 56 03 -> scene 4; BF 56 03 -> scene 5; B4 57 03 -> RESET. Official L12next MIDI table resolves the remaining scene controls: BC 59 03 = Scene 10, BD 59 03 = Scene Delete (value 03 follows verified button press convention). It also identifies B9 57 as RECORD BUTTON and BE 57 as OVERDUB MODE. CH1 fader confirmed from capture: B0 3C vv. Observed settled values: -inf=00, ~-20dB=1D, ~-10dB=35, 0dB=57.

commands.name: RECORD
commands.description: RECORD BUTTON according to the official L12next MIDI implementation (CC 0x57, MIDI channel 10). On the tested mixer this was observed to arm channels while Overdub mode was active.

commands.name: STOP
commands.description: Stops playback/transport. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: PLAY
commands.description: Starts playback ('PLAY SOUND'). Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: FF
commands.description: Fast-forward command verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: REW
commands.description: Rewind command verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_3
commands.description: Selects scene 3. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_RECALL
commands.description: Triggers RECALL for the currently selected scene. Verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_7

commands.name: OVERDUB_MODE
commands.description: OVERDUB MODE button according to the official L12next MIDI implementation (CC 0x57, MIDI channel 15).

commands.name: SCENE_SAVE
commands.description: Saves the currently selected scene. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_1_ALT
commands.description: Selects scene 1. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test. This byte sequence is NOT DELETE.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_2
commands.description: Selects scene 2. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_4
commands.description: Selects scene 4. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_5
commands.description: Selects scene 5. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_10
commands.description: Selects scene 10. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_DELETE
commands.description: Scene DELETE. Official L12next MIDI implementation lists CC 0x59 on MIDI channel 14 for Scene Delete. Value 03 matches the verified button-press convention; destructive hardware replay not yet performed.

commands.name: CH1_FADER
commands.description: Channel 1 fader. Official MIDI map: CC 0x3C (60), MIDI channel selects mixer channel. Capture verified B0 3C vv for CH1. In the test capture: -inf -> 00, about -20 dB -> 1D, about -10 dB -> 35, 0 dB -> 57.
